title: Page editor: surface slotted record-page slot blocks for editing
body:
While verifying the new schema-driven block pickers (#1494), I found the Studio page editor (PageBlockCanvas) surfaces full/region pages' blocks but NOT a slotted record page's slot blocks (slots.highlights / slots.details / slots.tabs[].children). Opening a kind:'slotted' page (e.g. app-showcase showcase_project_detail) shows the page-level object but no selectable blocks on the canvas, so its record:highlights / record:details / record:line_items can't be configured via the inspector (pickers included) — only via raw JSON.

Proposal: in PageBlockCanvas, when the page is kind:'slotted', surface the known slots (header/actions/alerts/highlights/details/tabs/discussion) as editable regions/blocks so the inspector + field pickers apply. The pickers themselves already work on full/region pages.

Found during: schema-driven object/field pickers (objectui #1494) + showcase richer project detail (framework #1605).
